Gulf-front community in Blue Mountain Beach

Just steps to private beach access

Complimentary beach chairs and umbrella service! (March-October)

Community gulf-front pool!

3 bedroom, 3 bath

4-star restaurants

Fun shops

Coastal Blue 422 by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 From March 1st to October 31st, take advantage of the complementary pair of beach chairs and an umbrella, ensuring a relaxing beach day without the hassle. Welcome to Coastal Blue 422, a gorgeous 3-bedroom, 3-bath condo, resting within a secluded and gated beachfront resort in Blue Mountain Beach. Enjoy peaceful beachside living with top-notch amenities, including a gulf front pool, hot tub, and private beach access! Convenience is prioritized with an elevator in the parking garage, making it easy to reach the top-floor. Extra parking is available near the basketball court, and guests are welcome to use the onsite gym. Enjoy a stroll on the pristine sands, just steps away. The charming and spacious interior opens to a 400-square-foot balcony, where stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico await. Relax in the cozy living room, with two recliners, a pull-out sofa, two chairs, and a 75" Smart TV—perfect for movie nights. Nearby dining options offer delightful take-out, or cook up your own meals in the fully equipped kitchen. The primary suite is a haven of relaxation featuring a king bed, oversized jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower, Smart TV, and private balcony seating for two.

Nice! The second bedroom offers a queen bed, TV, and balcony access. The third includes a king bed, TV, and easy access to a full bathroom in the hallway. Prepare for a memorable stay at Coastal Blue 422, where luxury meets laid-back beach life, crafting a vacation experience you won’t forget. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Gulf-front community - Private beach access - 3 bedrooms, 3 baths - 1618 sq ft - Community gulf-front pool - Complimentary beach service (seasonal March 1st - October 31st) - Parking in the garage is limited to 1 vehicle, but overflow parking is available outside of the garage. - Wi-Fi Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; private bath; TV - Queen bed in guest bunk room; private bath; TV - King in guest bedroom; hall bath; TV - Queen sleeper sofa in living room; hall bath; 75" TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
